SELECT 
    e.FirstName,
    e.LastName,
    SUM(InvoiceLine.Totals * InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    Employee e
JOIN 
    InvoiceLine il ON e.EmployeeId = il.EmployeeId
JOIN 
    Invoice invoice ON il.InvoiceId = invoice.InvoiceId
JOIN 
    Customer c ON invoice.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN 
    Artist a ON c.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
JOIN 
    SupportRep support ON c.SupportRepId = support.SupportRepId
GROUP BY 
    e.FirstName,
    e.LastName
ORDER BY 
    e.FirstName, e.LastName;

SELECT Title, (SUM(Milliseconds) / 1000) AS TotalMinutes
FROM Track
GROUP BY Title
ORDER BY TotalMinutes DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT Genre.Name) AS TrackCount
FROM Artist
JOIN Genre ON Artist.ArtistId = Genre.ArtistId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Genre.Name) > 1;

SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate
FROM Employee
WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY HireDate DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer ORDER BY FirstName, LastName;

SELECT Year, Name, COUNT(*) AS Quantity_Sold
FROM Invoice
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.Name = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Track ON Track.Name = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
GROUP BY Year, Genre.Name
ORDER BY Year, Genre.Name;

SELECT MONTH(CAST(HireDate AS DATE)), SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue, (SUM(Total) - SUM(Total)) / (SUM(Total) * 100) * 100 AS %Change
FROM Invoice
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Artist ON Invoice.CustomerId = Artist.ArtistId
JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId
JOIN Employee ON Invoice.CustomerId = Employee.EmployeeId
JOIN Genre ON Invoice.InvoiceDate = Genre.GenreId
JOIN MediaType ON Invoice.InvoiceDate = MediaType.MediaTypeId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId
JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON PlaylistTrack.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Track ON PlaylistTrack.TrackId = Track.TrackId
GROUP BY MONTH(CAST(HireDate AS DATE)), SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue, (SUM(Total) - SUM(Total)) / (SUM(Total) * 100) * 100
ORDER BY MONTH(CAST(HireDate AS DATE))

SELECT Name, ROUND((UnitPrice * Quantity * MediaTypeId * GenreId * Milliseconds * Bytes * UnitPrice * Quantity * 100) / (UnitPrice * Quantity * MediaTypeId * GenreId * Milliseconds * Bytes * UnitPrice * Quantity * 100), 2) AS Percentage
FROM Track
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId
JOIN MediaType ON Playlist.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY Playlist.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY Percentage DESC;

SELECT Artist.Name, AVG(Milliseconds) AS AverageMinutes
FROM Artist
JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId
JOIN Track ON Album.TrackId = Track.TrackId
GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
HAVING ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Artist WHERE TrackCount >= 10)
ORDER BY AVG(Milliseconds) DESC;

FROM countries

SELECT country_stats.iso3, country_stats.year, country_stats.gdp_usd, country_stats.gdp_per_capita_usd, country_stats.life_expectancy_years, country_stats.fertility_rate, country_stats.internet_users_pct, country_stats.unemployment_pct

SELECT
    country_stats.iso3,
    country_stats.year,
    country_stats.population,
    country_stats.gdp_usd,
    country_stats.gdp_per_capita_usd,
    country_stats.life_expectancy_years,
    country_stats.fertility_rate,
    country_stats.urban_population_pct,
    country_stats.internet_users_pct,
    country_stats.unemployment_pct
FROM
    country_stats
WHERE
    country_stats.year = 2023
ORDER BY
    country_stats.urban_population_pct DESC

    country_stats.iso3;

SELECT region, name, population
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2023
GROUP BY region, name, population
ORDER BY population DESC;

SELECT region, name, unemployment_pct
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
WHERE year = 2020
GROUP BY region, name, unemployment_pct
ORDER BY unemployment_pct DESC;

SELECT region, year, (life_expectancy_years / 1000000) AS average
FROM countries
JOIN country_stats ON countries.iso3 = country_stats.iso3
GROUP BY region, year
ORDER BY average DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT island FROM penguins;
SELECT body_mass_g FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female' AND year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM penguins) ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length FROM penguins;
SELECT species, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS average_body_mass FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

SELECT island, year, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins
FROM penguins
GROUP BY island, year
HAVING COUNT(*) = 1;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male';

SELECT species, AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS avg_flipper_length
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC;
SELECT species, MAX(bill_depth_mm), MIN(bill_depth_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT island, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY num_penguins DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT species, sex, AVG(body_mass_g) AS average_body_mass
FROM penguins
WHERE sex = 'male' OR sex = 'female'
GROUP BY species, sex
HAVING AVG(body_mass_g) IS NULL;

SELECT species, (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male') AS male_avg, (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female') AS female_avg FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY female_avg - male_avg DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g > (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'male' AND flipper_length_mm > 0 AND bill_length_mm > 0 AND bill_depth_mm > 0 AND sex = 'male' AND year = 2023);
SELECT * FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Biscoe' AND species = 'Gentoo';

SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS num_penguins_per_species_per_year
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, year
ORDER BY species, year;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT species, AVG(bill_length_mm / bill_depth_mm) AS ratio_avg FROM penguins GROUP BY species;

SELECT species, island, body_mass_g
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species, island
ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC;
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_2009 FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, island FROM penguins WHERE flipper_length_mm > (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins);

SELECT rank, species, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS average_bill_length
FROM penguins
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY average_bill_length DESC;
SELECT species, year, (bill_length_mm + bill_depth_mm + flipper_length_mm + body_mass_g) / 4 AS average_mass FROM penguins GROUP BY species, year;

SELECT FirstName, LastName, SUM(InvoiceLine.TrackId * UnitPrice) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer
JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN Artist ON InvoiceLine.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
JOIN Album ON InvoiceLine.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId
JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId
JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId
GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 3;
